items.text: Saquon Barkley is active tonight for the Eagles vs Cowboys.
items.why: Official inactives list and Schefter confirmation; Rapoport noted he is up along with OL/TE.
items.implication: Full workload expected as lead back; no reverse of prior beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Maintains RB1 snaps, carries, red-zone role vs DAL.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially is active today vs. the Raiders despite calf injury; sources optimistic pregame.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirm active; ETR had GTD-optimism; Berry noted active.
items.implication: WR1 role intact; monitor any snap limitation but no major dock expected.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; was unlikely after limited participation returning from quad.
items.why: Rapoport sources said unlikely, then inactive; Schefter listed inactive; ETR GTD-pessimism.
items.implication: Opens backfield for backups; Hall miss extends recovery.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles MNF vs DAL.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter detailed via McManus.
items.implication: Elevates remaining Eagles pass-catchers (Goedert, Lemon/slot, others) in targets/routes.
items.opportunity: Increased target share and routes for healthy WRs/TEs; Berry bet on Lemon yards.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos backfield snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21% snaps. Berry LOVE/upgrade, roster in 100% leagues; waivers top add.
items.why: Berry per-player Love with usage lead; ETR IN; Boone/Fitz waivers #1; Payton wants more touches.
items.implication: Coleman primary ROS over Dobbins (inefficient); flex/RB2 upside.
items.opportunity: Expanded snaps/carries/routes/3rd down vs split; Dobbins downgraded.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; Garafolo/NFL: expected to be OK after intimating injury.
items.why: Levitan thinks actually hurt; ETR watching; NFL roundup expected OK.
items.implication: Monitor practice; if limited, Tracy or others rise but Tracy also hamstring.
items.opportunity: Potential snap reduction opens backup role.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after purposeful slide ankle turn; pain went away quickly, coach Campbell 'should be good'.
items.why: Levitan: almost certainly fine; player and coach updates confirm temporary pain only.
items.implication: No miss expected Week 8; full RB1 role continues.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey (quad/hamstring) returned to game; Shanahan: mild hamstring strain, pretty optimistic fine after bye.
items.why: ETR watching quad returned; NFL.com mild hamstring, optimistic post-bye.
items.implication: Bye helps; low miss risk Week 9+; monitor Week 8 status if any.
items.opportunity: Role secure long-term; short-term handcuff if limited.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT; Ravens start Huntley. Coach later notes working hard, decent spot for Week 8 but more Wednesday.
items.why: ETR summary OUT; Schefter confirmed ruled out high-ankle; NFL roundup Week 8 optimism.
items.implication: Huntley start tanks Ravens pass game ceiling; Flowers/Andrews/Likely usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Reduced QB rushing; possible short-yardage to RBs.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN and back for Packers; Berry discusses ROS fantasy value expectations.
items.why: ETR IN; Schefter activated expected to play; Berry video on ROS.
items.implication: Reclaims lead RB role; monitor workload post-absence.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, goal-line preferred; reduces prior handcuff value.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 ppg via 9 carries inside 5 and league-lead 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan player-specific data on goal-line/targets sustaining value despite efficiency woes; backup better YPC.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via opportunity; ceiling if efficiency improves or volume holds.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/goal-line and target share drive fantasy over pure rushing.
items.conflict: Efficiency conflict with volume thesis but opportunity first.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; Berry: if you can turn big game into sell-high opportunity, take it.
items.why: Berry specific Hate/sell after explosion; prior performance context limited sustainability.
items.implication: Trade while value peaked; not long-term RB1 lock.
items.opportunity: Usage may regress; monitor Titans depth.

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24/29 lead; Tank Dell only 6 in return (first since 2024); Noel 15 left early turf toe; Harrison 8.
items.why: Levitan exact route counts; Dell eased back, Nico clear alpha.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell stash/handcuff with ramp-up potential; Noel watch.
items.opportunity: Nico full routes/targets; Dell low share initially expands others short-term.

items.text: Chiefs WR routes without Rice: Xavier Worthy 33 of 36 dropbacks (near full), but has never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games; others fill secondary.
items.why: Levitan data post-Rice absence; high volume but historical ceiling limit.
items.implication: Volume WR3/flex with Mahomes but capped upside without breakthrough.
items.opportunity: Dominant routes/targets in Rice void; monitor for efficiency bump.
